post_content:
Almost 11 mo ago, I posted a comment on importance of EDA when Rahul Lanka
asked me. Reposting ! Importance of Exploratory Data Analysis In a DS project,
your model can be a black box but your data shouldn't be. To understand what
are the features, sizes, shape, their ranges, number of unique values, how
they are correlated to target variable etc. and a lot more, you need to do
EDA. And there are tons of ideas (hypothesis), you generate while doing EDA.
For example, in a regression problem, I realized doing clustering and
generating a new feature with clustered labels and then proceeding with
regression helped me increase accuracy. It made business sense too. I saw many
such benefits of EDA in real life. EDA is advanced version of reporting /BI/
dashboard. Business wise, it adds much more value than modelling. If your
model fails, your client may still be happy with insights you gave from EDA.
Hence, it's a backup deliverable. EDA is exhaustive so there are some basic
factors to check but it's not a sing list. If you are keen on getting good at
EDA, go to kaggle, pick popular competitions and check out kernels with EDA.

Lot of posts in LinkedIn on Udacity Intel Edge AI scholarship If you have seen
my article on 2020 Trends (first comment below 👇), I had called out Edge
Analytics/AI as one of the key trends to watch out for While this is not new
but we can see more and more smart devices entering the market in coming
years. It can be smart microwave, smart security camera, smart cities, home
automation among others 💎How is edge AI different from regular analytics? Edge
analytics enables models to be deployed closer to devices or process to reduce
latency of decision process Edge devices are limited by compute and memory and
deploying models on edge devices might require special hardware accelerators
like Edge TPU or Edge GPU as well as technique like model quantization or
TensorRT that trims down model size for edge and increases model performance
If you want to know more Edge Analytics and model quantization you can see my
video below 📌 https://lnkd.in/gRNDeU9 📌 https://lnkd.in/ghWAbzu Sample
business case on IOT devices video 📌 https://lnkd.in/gT-nYQZ Congrats to those

Tap the menu bar on the top-left of the app. Choose “Your Timeline.” Tap the

Select “Automatically delete location history.” Change the setting from “Keep
until I delete manually” to “Keep for 18 months” or “Keep for 3 months.”
